verdict.rationale: AgentMail pushes email events to your code through webhooks (a POST to a registered URL as soon as an event happens) and real-time WebSockets. Allow/block Lists act as simple declarative filtering rules, and webhook events can be routed per pod. Beyond that, the user must write their own handler code to turn events into actions, because no built-in rule engine or condition-to-action configuration is documented. Missing for 10: native declarative rule or automation builder, documented event types and condition matching, built-in actions triggered without custom code, independent hands-on corroboration.
